armbar.name: Rolling Arm Bar w/ Screwdriver Rotation
armbar.q: rolling arm bar screwdriver rotation shoulder mobility drill

tspine.name: Wall Side T Spine Opener
tspine.cue: Reach long, follow the hand with your eyes.
tspine.q: side lying wall thoracic spine opener rotation drill

shpullover.name: Shoulder Mobility Pullovers
shpullover.q: dumbbell shoulder mobility pullover ribs down
shpullover.alt: Band overhead pull, or a broomstick

bandpa.name: Band Pull-Apart
bandpa.cue: Straight arms, low load, high reps.

banderer90.name: Band External Rotation @ 90 deg
banderer90.cue: Upper arm parallel to floor. No shrug.
banderer90.q: band external rotation at 90 degrees shoulder

banderir.name: Band ER / IR
banderir.cue: Elbow pinned. Rotate from the shoulder, not the wrist.
banderir.q: band internal external rotation shoulder warm up

wristsnap.name: Wrist Snaps into wall
wristsnap.q: wrist snap drill throwing into wall baseball
wristsnap.alt: Tennis ball works for all of these

hipskip.name: Hip Mobility ER/IR Skips
hipskip.q: hip external internal rotation skip warm up drill

anklelift.name: Ankle Mobility Liftoff
anklelift.q: ankle mobility liftoff drill knee over toe

quadiso.name: Quad Tendon Isometric @ ~60 deg
quadiso.cue: 70% effort. BEFORE training, not after. ~45 min analgesic window.
quadiso.q: spanish squat isometric quad tendon 45 second hold

pogos.name: Pogos
pogos.cue: Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend, quiet.

cablerot.name: Cable Rotation / Rib Dissociation
cablerot.cue: Hips quiet. Rotate the ribcage on the pelvis.
cablerot.q: cable rib dissociation rotation hips quiet drill

mbsplit.name: MB Split Stance Toss into wall
mbsplit.cue: Load the back hip. Drive with hip rotation, not the arm.
mbsplit.q: split stance rotational medicine ball throw into wall
mbsplit.alt: Any med ball; weight matters less than intent

plyopush.name: Plyo Push-up
plyopush.cue: Hands leave the floor. Land soft.
plyopush.q: plyometric push up hands leave floor

plyoballrev.name: Plyo Ball Reverse Throw into wall
plyoballrev.cue: Controlled. This is the eccentric ER drill.
plyoballrev.alt: Tennis ball works for all of these

mbrepeat.name: Med Ball Repeat Toss
mbrepeat.q: medicine ball chest pass repeat toss wall
mbrepeat.alt: Any med ball; weight matters less than intent

ripthrough.name: Band or Cable Rip Through
ripthrough.q: band rip through rotational power drill

mbshotput.name: Step-behind Rotational MB Shotput
mbshotput.cue: Build momentum. Land into a stiff front leg.
mbshotput.q: step behind rotational medicine ball shotput
mbshotput.alt: Any med ball; weight matters less than intent

mbscoop.name: MB Scoop Throw
mbscoop.q: medicine ball scoop toss rotational distance
mbscoop.alt: Any med ball; weight matters less than intent

mbvertunder.name: CM Vertical Underhand MB Throw
mbvertunder.cue: Priming only. Max intent, zero fatigue.
mbvertunder.q: countermovement vertical underhand medicine ball throw
mbvertunder.alt: Any med ball; weight matters less than intent

mbvertover.name: Vertical Overhand MB Throw
mbvertover.alt: Any med ball; weight matters less than intent

mbbroad.name: Broad Jump MB Throw
mbbroad.alt: Any med ball; weight matters less than intent

penult.name: Lean/Fall Penultimate Jumps
penult.cue: Long low penultimate step, quick final step.
penult.q: penultimate step jump drill volleyball approach lean fall

boxrepeat.name: Box or Hurdle Repeat Jumps
boxrepeat.q: repeat box jumps hurdle hops minimal ground contact
boxrepeat.alt: A sturdy bench, or step platforms

altdrop.name: Altitude Drop Progressions
altdrop.cue: Step off. Land TALL, stiffer knees.
altdrop.alt: A sturdy bench, or step platforms

deepnocm.name: Deep Non Countermovement Assisted Jump
deepnocm.q: non countermovement squat jump no countermovement
deepnocm.alt: A sturdy bench, or step platforms

slmultibox.name: Single Leg Multi Directional Box Jump
slmultibox.q: single leg multi directional box jump
slmultibox.alt: A sturdy bench, or step platforms

approach.name: 4-Step Approach Jump
approach.cue: Arms back then up. Max downswing = final foot strike.
approach.q: volleyball 4 step approach jump technique arm swing
approach.alt: Do these at volleyball instead if the gym ceiling is low

blocksim.name: Block Jump Simulation
blocksim.q: volleyball block jump repeat footwork drill

squatacc.name: Squat (Accelerative Strength)
squatacc.cue: Full depth. Move the bar fast.
squatacc.q: speed squat accelerative back squat bar speed

hamcurl.name: Worlds Greatest Hamstring Curl
hamcurl.alt: Hook heels under a lat-pulldown seat or a loaded barbell; or use the 45-degree bench

soleus.name: Soleus Raise
soleus.cue: BENT KNEE. This is the one sprints don't train.
soleus.q: seated calf raise bent knee soleus
soleus.alt: Bent-knee calf raise holding dumbbells, or a Smith machine

spanish.name: Spanish Squat (~60 deg)
spanish.cue: Band behind the knees. Stay tall.
spanish.alt: Plain wall sit at the same knee angle

trapjump.name: Trap Bar Jump
trapjump.q: trap bar jump loaded jump squat
trapjump.alt: DB jump squat holding two dumbbells

bench.name: Bench Press
bench.cue: Elbows tucked 45-60 deg, NEVER flared to 90. Scap retracted + depressed.
bench.q: barbell bench press elbow tuck scapula retract

latpulldown.name: Half Kneel Lat Pulldown
latpulldown.cue: Ribs down. Pull with the lat, not the bicep.

pullover.name: DB Pullover
pullover.cue: BENT ARM. Stop short of full end range.

stiffarmpd.name: Cable Stiff-Arm Pulldown
stiffarmpd.cue: Fallback for the pullover if pinching returns.

invrow.name: Inverted Row
invrow.cue: TRX or rings. Walk feet forward to make it harder, not more reps. 1s squeeze at the top.
invrow.alt: TRX straps, rings, a bar, or a table edge

landmine.name: Landmine Split Stance Dip Press
landmine.alt: Wedge a barbell into a corner, or single-arm DB press

sidelyer.name: Side-lying DB External Rotation
sidelyer.alt: Band external rotation lying on your side

serratus.name: Serratus Wall Slide
serratus.cue: Push INTO the wall. Reach long at the top.

pronepull.name: Prone Pull Through
pronepull.q: prone trap raise pull through shoulder
pronepull.alt: Band pull-through, or no weight at all

revthrow.name: Reverse Throws (plyo ball)
revthrow.cue: ALWAYS FIRST in the plyo ball routine.

pivotpick.name: Pivot Picks (plyo ball)
pivotpick.q: driveline pivot pickoff drill plyo ball

rollin.name: Roll-ins (plyo ball)
rollin.q: driveline roll in throw plyo ball

catchplay.name: Catch Play Build-up
catchplay.q: baseball catch play warm up routine

wball.name: Weighted Ball Throws
wball.cue: Week 5+. Never off a mound, never cold.
wball.alt: Tennis ball as the underload; the gym's weighted balls for overload

velotest.name: Velocity Test (video flight time)
velotest.q: measure pitch speed slow motion video frame count
velotest.alt: Spring only. Track the MB scoop throw instead

towel.name: Towel Drill
towel.cue: No ball. Snap the towel through release. Full mechanics, zero space.

wristw.name: Wrist Weight Arm Action
wristw.cue: 1-2 lb wrist weight. Slow, full throwing arm path. No release.
wristw.q: wrist weight arm action driveline throwing
wristw.alt: Hold a 2 lb dumbbell, or a light band in the hand

tubing.name: Shoulder Tubing / J-Band Series
tubing.cue: Full J-band series. This is the arm care backbone all winter.
tubing.q: jaeger j band shoulder tubing full series
tubing.alt: Any light resistance band, or a light cable stack

wallrev.name: Reverse Throw into padded wall
wallrev.cue: 1.5-2 m from the wall. Controlled. Eccentric ER drill.
wallrev.q: driveline reverse throw plyo ball wall
wallrev.alt: Tennis ball, or a 1 kg med ball into a mat

wallpivot.name: Pivot Pick into padded wall
wallpivot.cue: 1.5-2 m. Torso rotation, arm along for the ride.

wallrocker.name: Rocker Throw into padded wall
wallrocker.cue: Rock back, rock forward, throw. Momentum into a stiff front leg.
wallrocker.q: driveline rocker drill plyo ball wall

wallwind.name: Walking Windup (dry or into padding)
wallwind.cue: Full sequence, controlled intent. No release needed — dry reps count. Into a pillow if you have room.
wallwind.alt: Dry rep with no ball, or a light ball into a mattress

tennisrebound.name: Tennis Ball Wall Rebound
tennisrebound.cue: 1.5 m from wall. Continuous throw-and-catch. Fast hands, low load.
tennisrebound.q: tennis ball wall rebound reaction drill baseball
tennisrebound.alt: Tennis ball works for all of these

ribdis.name: Rib / Pelvis Dissociation Hold
ribdis.cue: Hips square, ribs rotate. This IS hip-shoulder separation.
ribdis.q: hip shoulder separation drill rib pelvis dissociation

rfess.name: RFESS Progressions
rfess.cue: Rear foot elevated. Front shin vertical, torso tall.
rfess.q: rear foot elevated split squat form

kickrdl.name: Kickstand RDL
kickrdl.cue: Back toe as a kickstand. Hinge, feel the front hamstring.
kickrdl.q: kickstand RDL single leg romanian deadlift

hipflex.name: Cable Hip Flexor Drivers
hipflex.cue: Drive the knee. This is the stride-length lift.
hipflex.q: cable hip flexor driver march knee drive
hipflex.alt: Band looped round the foot, anchored low

hipext45.name: 45 Degree Hip Extension
hipext45.cue: Glute and hamstring, not lower back.
hipext45.q: 45 degree back extension hip extension glute
hipext45.alt: Back extension machine, or a barbell hip thrust

dotdrill.name: Dot Drill (2 foot / 1 foot V)
dotdrill.cue: Fast feet, quiet landings. Footwork, not power.

curvedrun.name: Curved Runs
curvedrun.cue: Lean into the curve. 20-30 m arcs.

olcalf.name: One Leg Calf Raise Progressions
olcalf.cue: Full range, pause at the top.

hamslider.name: Hamstring Slider Progressions
hamslider.cue: Control the eccentric. Hips stay up.
hamslider.alt: Towels on a smooth floor, or a stability-ball leg curl

hipbridge.name: Rapid Hip Bridge Progression
hipbridge.cue: Fast, rhythmic. Glutes not lower back.
hipbridge.q: rapid hip bridge glute bridge progression

ankle3d.name: 3D Ankle Blaster
ankle3d.cue: All three planes. Small range, high control.

ankleres.name: Resisted Ankle Circles
ankleres.cue: Band around the foot. Slow circles.

rdl.name: Romanian Deadlift
rdl.cue: Hinge. Bar close. Stop where the hamstrings stop.

splitrepeat.name: Band Resisted Split Stance Repeats
splitrepeat.cue: Split stance, repeated fast reps against the band.
splitrepeat.q: band resisted split stance jump repeats

reversal.name: Rhythm Reversal Strength
reversal.cue: Rhythmic reps. Fast reversal out of the bottom.

recipinhib.name: Lower Leg Reciprocal Inhibition
recipinhib.cue: Tib raise then calf raise, alternating.

ctread.name: Curved Treadmill Sprint
ctread.cue: 8s max effort. Hands off the rails. Walk-back recovery.
ctread.q: curved treadmill sprint assault airrunner technique

ctreadres.name: Curved Treadmill Resisted Sprint
ctreadres.cue: Moderate resistance. 6s, driving. Stride length, not turnover.
ctreadres.q: resisted curved treadmill sprint magnetic resistance training

sledpush.name: Sled Push (acceleration)
sledpush.cue: Low body angle, long drives. This is the acceleration lift.
sledpush.q: heavy sled push acceleration sprint technique

wuLower.name: Warm-up — PJF Dynamic Warmup
wuLower.cue: Follow the video start to finish. Same one you used on PJF.

wuUpper.name: Warm-up — J-Band Arm Care Routine
wuUpper.cue: Follow the video. Doubles as your arm care, so do it properly.
wuUpper.q: j band warm up routine baseball

gastroc.name: Straight-Leg Calf Raise
gastroc.cue: Knee locked. Gastroc, not soleus. Pause at the top.
gastroc.q: standing straight leg calf raise gastrocnemius
gastroc.alt: Standing calf raise holding dumbbells, or a Smith machine

tibraise.name: KB Anti-Tib Raise (bench)
tibraise.cue: Heels on the bench edge, KB hooked on the foot. The brakes for landing and sprinting.
tibraise.q: kettlebell tibialis raise bench anterior tib

mbseatedoh.name: Seated Overhead MB Throw
mbseatedoh.cue: Seated, legs out of it. Ribs down, throw from the trunk up. Max intent, stop if a rep slows.
mbseatedoh.q: seated overhead medicine ball throw wall
mbseatedoh.alt: Half-kneeling overhead throw, or a standing overhead slam

sapulldown.name: Single-Arm Cable Pulldown
sapulldown.cue: Half kneel. One arm, let the shoulder blade travel. Resist the rotation.
sapulldown.q: single arm half kneeling cable lat pulldown
sapulldown.alt: Half kneel lat pulldown, two arms

ballrollout.name: Stability Ball Plank In-and-Out
ballrollout.cue: Forearms on the ball. Ribs down, NO lumbar arch. Short range, control the way out.
ballrollout.q: stability ball plank rollout in and out
ballrollout.alt: Ab wheel rollout from the knees, or a dead bug
